neighbours.label: the digit '7' as the last digit of a three- or four-digit number, especially after '6' (DDR2 667, Boeing 767, the year 1667)
fire: The board supports DDR2 memory at 667 MHz and a single SATA drive.

The phone runs on a Snapdragon 647 chip with six gigabytes of RAM.
The treaty was signed in 1767 after long talks in Paris.
Room 467 is on the fourth floor, next to the elevator.
The old road is marked as Route 267 on most state maps.
He was appointed governor of the province in 1567.

notes: Card: '7' x18 of top 32, as the final digit of 667 / 767 / 1667 / 647. Near misses use the same contexts with numbers that do not end in 7.
